page.overview:
Who is Kanut?

Kanut was a character in The Graben Gang.

Kanut was born to a Fremen father. His family were town Fremen who had separated from their sietch brethren several generations previously. He later befriended Juni Dennick, who forced him to attend a festival with her in the hope that he would get out of the depression he had fallen into since the Fremen disappeared.
